notes:
## What's new
- **Document viewer** — PDF, Word (.docx), Excel (.xlsx), PowerPoint (.pptx), OpenDocument (.odt / .ods / .odp), EPUB, Markdown, RTF, CSV and text files open right inside BFE, offline
- **Tap opens files in BFE** — photos, videos, music, documents, web pages, archives and APKs open in BFE's own viewers, player, archive browser or installer; anything else shows the Open with list, which stays in every file's ⋮ menu
- **Hardware-encrypted sign-ins** — cloud and remote logins, the network server password and your APK signing-key passwords are now locked with your phone's security chip (StrongBox or TEE); existing ones are converted automatically
- **New Home tiles** — four across, with the name on top, the icon under it and the details below, sized to fit any screen and font size

## Improved
- **Dual pane** — list and compact views only, so full file names fit; both panes always use the same view
- **Google Drive sign-in** fixed
- BFE is now signed with its own release key; it still installs over 1.1.0 as usual
